tests/seo.test.ts > SEO middleware > excludes redirect-only and noindex docs routes from the sitemap
src/agent-session/acpmux/subagents/agentRuns.test.ts > agentRun > a recorded Codex review through reach, its prompt on stdin
src/agent-session/acpmux/composer/pastedTextChipModel.test.ts > one long paragraph has only its characters, never 1 line
test/agent-pane-send-morph.test.ts > a new chat's first prompt: nothing flies, the prompt fades in place
test/composer-footer-essentials.test.ts > a new chat's location row names the folder without this Mac's path
test/run-in-background.test.ts > isBackgroundKey > not B, ⌘B (the sidebar's) or Ctrl-B with another modifier
test/menu-press-guard.test.ts > other press handlers can tell a press that only closes the menu (the transcript's margin drag)
test/subagent-tray.test.tsx > a tray line says what it is and what a click does > a lone ended line is settled on the composer's glass; a headed settled tray keeps its own surface
test/turn-end-reply-motion-browser.test.ts > motion off before the end: the end applies at once, nothing plays or settles on after
tests/app-session-handoff-route.test.ts > app session handoff > fails closed outside Vercel when running in production
test/composer-plain-glyphs.test.ts > chromium: the chat's Send is the mic's plain glyph in the secondary text color; hover is the mic's pill, a press adds nothing
test/thread-minimap-left-rail-stays.test.ts > webkit: in a 780px pane the rail stays pinned while the chat moves
tests/vm-private-network.test.ts > team tunnel reconciliation > never returns a tunnel that a revoke deleted while team networks reconciled
test/permission-ask-row-look.test.ts > chromium: the whole ask shows when the stack's height is definite
